name: smart-defaults

input-review.notes: Auto-approve. NOTE: this gate never actually fired before B2/B8 (its skip condition was satisfied by the parse that had just run), so "parsing is reliable" was never verified by anyone. A reject needs prose corrections, which only a human can supply.

character-ids.notes: Character mapping requires human judgment - skip for auto mode

evidence-and-photos.notes: Curated bundle is ready for arc analysis

arc-selection.notes: Select 3 arcs prioritizing strong evidence and accusation-driven

photos.notes: Use the default data/<id>/photos folder the gate reports. The gate only fires when no path was given at /start.

outline.notes: Outline structure is guided by selected arcs
